<tutorialgesture>{Get ready for battle!}\r\nLoot the Weapon Rack
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} to pick up items or\r\nuse the Interact button
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} to pick up <gem>{Skill Gem}
<gem>{Skill gems} <tutorialgesture>{must be equipped \r\nto harness its power}\r\n<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} to open your Character Menu
Navigate to the Skills Tab
<tutorialgesture>{[Drag and Drop]} the <gem>{Skill Gem}\r\ninto a skill gem socket
<tutorialgesture>{New skill acquired!}\r\nClose the Character Menu
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} or <tutorialgesture>{[Tap-Hold]} to\r\ndisplay item information
<tutorialgesture>{[Drag and Drop]} the <gem>{Skill gem}\r\nto take the item
[DNT]END OF SKILL GEM TUTORIAL. HIGHLIGHT SKILL BUTTON ASSOCIATED TO STARTING SKILL GEM
Pick up <gem>{Support Gem}
<gem>{Support gems} <tutorialgesture>{are used to augment \r\nyour} <gem>{Skill gems}\r\nOpen your Character Menu
Navigate to the Skills Tab
Place the <gem>{Support Gem} into\r\na support socket of the same colour
<tutorialgesture>{Your skill has been augmented!}\r\nClose the Character Menu
<tutorialgesture>{You have taken damage!}\r\n<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} a Life Flask or\r\nyour Life Orb to recover
<tutorialgesture>{Combat has begun!}\r\n<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} to attack
<tutorialgesture>{Welcome to the Atlas of Worlds!}\r\nTo get started, we will introduce \r\nsome controls
<tutorialgesture>{[Drag]} to look around
<tutorialgesture>{[Pinch]} to zoom in on the Atlas
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} to select the map
[DNT]END OF ATLAS TOUCH CONTROLS TUTORIAL. CLEAN UP TUTORIAL GESTURE STUFF HERE
<tutorialgesture>{The Map Device only creates six Portals to an Area}\r\nThis means there are only six Entrances before an Area is closed permanently. Tread carefully!
<tutorialgesture>{Introducing the Character Passive Skill Tree!}\r\nSkill points are used to enhance your character
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} Passive Skill to see its Stats
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} Assign Mode button\r\nto start Allocating
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} to select a Passive Skill\r\nto allocate
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap-Hold]} Confirm button to apply changes\r\n<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} Passive Skill again to deselect\r\nand choose another option
<tutorialgesture>{Your character has grown in power!}\r\nSkill points are gained through levelling up, \r\nand completing certain quests.
[DNT]END OF PASSIVE TREE CONTROLS TUTORIAL. JUST COMPLETE TUTORIAL

<tutorialgesture>{Portal Scrolls are used to create Checkpoints}
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} the Portal Button to create a portal 
back to town.
<tutorialgesture>{Reminder:} You only have six Portals before the Map Device must be Reactivated!
[DNT]END OF PORTAL SCROLL TUTORIAL. JUST TURN OFF GLOW AND COMPLETE TUTORIAL
<tutorialgesture>{The Minimap can be used to help navigate the Area}\r\nExpand the map by <tutorialgesture>{[Tapping]} the Minimap
<tutorialgesture>{[Drag]} the Joystick to move the Map\r\nClose the Map Overlay by <tutorialgesture>{[Tapping]} the Joystick
[DNT]END OF MINIMAP TUTORIAL. JUST COMPLETE THE TUTORIAL
<tutorialgesture>{Virtue Gem Crafting}\r\nGem Artisans can craft Uncut Gems to unleash Skills within
<tutorialgesture>{[Drag]} the Uncut Skill Gem\r\ninto crafting slot

<tutorialgesture>{[Swipe]} through the Archetypes
to see available Skills
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} the Skill Icons to view the
details of the Virtue
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} the Engrave button \r\nto create a new <gem>{Skill Gem}
<tutorialgesture>{This Skill requirements a higher\r\nItem Level Uncut Skill Gem}\r\nPick a new skill to Engrave
<tutorialgesture>{[Drag]} the <gem>{Skill Gem} back to your Inventory
<tutorialgesture>{Tutorial Complete!}\r\nWhen you are ready to equip the crafted <gem>{Skill Gem} \r\ngo to the Skills menu and drag it into the slot
[DNT]END OF SKILL GEM CRAFTING TUTORIAL. JUST COMPLETE THE TUTORIAL
<tutorialgesture>{Your character has two Weapon Sets}\r\nWeapon Sets switch automatically to meet Skill requirements as they are used, but switching weapons takes time!
[DNT]END OF TUTORIAL. JUST SET COMPLETE FLAG
<tutorialgesture>{You have found an unidentified Item}\r\nAn Item must be identified before\r\nit can be equipped
<tutorialgesture>{[Drag]} and use a Scroll of Wisdom\r\non an unidentified Item
<tutorialgesture>{The Item is now identified}\r\nIn each Town, There will be a Vendor who will identify all your Items free of charge!
[DNT]END OF TUTORIAL. JUST SET COMPLETE FLAG
<tutorialgesture>{[Tap]} to use the Well\r\nWells restore Life, Mana, and Flask Charges
